summary: Iteration 69 - Shareable Public Plans Feature Testing Complete. All backend API tests passed (9/9). All frontend UI tests passed. The public plan page at /plano/{slug} is fully functional with hero, share bar, map preview teaser, CTAs, and OG meta tags.

Backend: GET /api/og-image/nonexistent-slug returns 404

Backend: Plan itinerary has day, title, activities structure

critical_code_review_comments: All Shareable Public Plans features implemented correctly per specification
Backend /api/plan/{slug} endpoint returns full plan data for public access
Backend /api/og-image/{slug} generates dynamic PNG images using PIL (Pillow)
Frontend PublicPlan.js has all required data-testid attributes for testing
SEO component correctly sets og:image, og:title, og:description, twitter:card meta tags
Local tips are limited to 3 for public visitors with lock message for additional tips
Map preview teaser shows 'Mapa interativo exclusivo para Embaixadores' lock message
Share functionality works: WhatsApp opens share dialog, Copy link copies URL to clipboard

seed_data_creation: None - used existing public plan with slug 'paris-acbc2d'
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 69 verified Shareable Public Plans feature. Key findings: (1) Public plan page at /plano/{slug} is accessible without authentication. (2) OG image endpoint at /api/og-image/{slug} generates dynamic PNG images (1200x630) with destination, dates, and summary. (3) SEO component dynamically sets og:image, og:title, og:description, twitter:card meta tags via JavaScript. (4) Share bar has WhatsApp button (opens wa.me share), Copy link button (copies URL), and native share button (uses Web Share API). (5) Local tips are limited to 3 for public visitors with '+N dicas exclusivas para Embaixadores' message. (6) Map preview teaser shows locked state for non-ambassadors. (7) CTAs include 'Criar o meu roteiro com IA' (links to /travel-planner) and 'Contribuir para esta viagem' (only shows if plan has journey_id). (8) Known public plan slugs: paris-acbc2d, lisboa-6f4f3e, porto-487baf.
